I think this is the stupidest dog movie I've ever seen. Very low budget and weak plot. The starring dog, Lobo, is supposed to be half hunting dog and half wolf, but obviously doesn't have a speck of wolf blood. He's just an ordinary German Shepherd. The she-wolf looks like a Husky. And anyhow, I don't think wolves have litters that large. Besides the fact it seems rather unlikely that a wild she-wolf would have mated with a domestic dog. The writers didn't seem to know much about wolf behavior. The only redeeming feature of this movie was a few interesting wildlife shots.
No animals were harmed in the making of this picture

With the exception of the animals used in the making of this picture..If I'm not mistaken both Lobo AND the "she wolf" were both male which would make it kind of difficult to have puppies, but heck, it's HOLLYweird.. You have to kind of accept that audiences of the time were mainly city dwellers with little livestock experience so the producers could likely pull anything over on them..Few wildlife documentaries had been made then. it wasn't like PBS's Nature was a long running docudrama at the time.

Green Acres is one of the best shows of all times, period. It's full of stupid people who are stupid in different ways - the stupid big city lawyer, the stupid glamorous wife, the stupid farmer and his stupid wife, the stupid farm hand, the stupid county agent, the stupid handymen, - all uniquely stupid in their own way, About the only one who isn't stupid is the pig. Green Acres swirls in a psychedelic kaleidoscope with just faint, occasional, brief connections to reality; and spirals into more and more absurdity that requires LSD to understand.
